title: feat(objectql)!: a picklist, mapping or dataset name holds one package (bare-name phase 1, 1/4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DTo6jRMNdsU1vzk7FgXhuZm)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1EuHiCqvh8VEz81QD

Refs #30803 (PR 1 of 4; the last PR of the series carries `Fixes`)

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`) and item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) refuse, after the cold boot, a package registration they accepted before: one whose picklist, mapping or dataset bears a name another installed package holds. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` does not teach that two packages may share a picklist, mapping or dataset name, and the naming rule is phase 2's (#30805); the prescription ships in the refusal and warning text and in ADR-0048's 2026-11-06 addendum.

⚠️ **Tier H**: this diff touches `docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` (§3.4 narrowing note + addendum). The seat routes the approver.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按裁决 C 第一阶段，picklist、mapping、dataset 三类名字一个部署只能有一个包持有。冷启动结束（`kernel:bootstrapped`）后，第二个包再声明同名项，在安装入口和注册入口都被拒（422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`），提示里点出两个持有包和改名建议（命名空间前缀，如 `beta_status`）。
- 为什么：实测两包同名时，字段的 picklist、导入的 mappingName、仪表盘的 datasetName 都不带包上下文，谁先注册就给谁，另一个包被默默错配（picklist 甚至拒绝自己包的取值）。
- 冷启动：已经同名的部署照常启动，只打一条告警，点名两个持有包和改名；开关 `BARE_NAME_COLD_BOOT_MODE` 默认 `'warn'`，等你裁决是否改成拒绝启动。
- 不变的：同一包重装或热重载；环境里同名覆盖（ADR-0005 覆盖层，从不算持有者）；其它类型（page、按对象的 action、job 等）继续共存；`OS_METADATA_COLLISION=warn` 不降级。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`（规则与开关）、`registry.ts` 的 `refuseBareNameConflicts` / `sealBareNameHolders`、`plugin.ts` 的 `kernel:bootstrapped` 封印、ADR-0048 新附录。
- 需要你做的：ADR 改动是 Tier H，需要审批人批准；冷启动拒绝还是告警，等你一句话。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`** (new) — the rule and its vocabulary, the security catalog's sibling (`security-catalog-namespace.ts`) generalised: the covered types (`picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`), the declared names a manifest carries (`declaredBareNames`, the engine's own collection sources, nested `plugins[]` one level), the holders (a package; a built-in, none today), the rename (`suggestedBareNameRename`: the namespace prefixed), and the one cold-boot switch `BARE_NAME_COLD_BOOT_MODE` (`'warn'`).
- **`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`** —
  - `BareNameConflictError`: the ADR-0112 envelope (`code: 'NAMESPACE_CONFLICT'`, `status: 422`), every conflict in one refusal, `conflicts[]` of `{ type, name, incomingPackageId, existingHolder, rename }`.
  - The package door: `installPackage` asks `refuseBareNameConflicts` ahead of every mutation (after the security catalog's and the default record page's refusals), records the package's claims, and `uninstallPackage` forgets them. No co-owner exemption, no `collisionPolicy` downgrade.
  - The item seam: `registerItem` refuses a package-bound picklist, mapping or dataset over another package's name.
  - One predicate for both doors (`bareNameHoldersOtherThan`): empty until sealed, empty when the incoming package already holds the name; holders are composite `<packageId>:<name>` slots in serving order plus install claims. ⛔ The bare slot (the environment catalog) is never read.
  - `sealBareNameHolders()` (the seal + every name the boot left held twice, sorted) and the module-level `sealBareNameHoldersAtColdBoot(registry, mode, logger)` (warn once, or refuse with `door: 'cold-boot'`).
- **`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`** — the engine plugin seals at `kernel:bootstrapped` (after the `kernel:ready` install-local rehydrate), under `BARE_NAME_COLD_BOOT_MODE`.
- **`packages/objectql/src/security-catalog-namespace.ts`** — one header sentence ("for every other type §3.4's coexistence stands") points at the sibling.
- **`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md`** (Tier H) — a "Narrowed (2026-11-06)" note under §3.4, an Addenda-line entry, and the addendum: ruling C's text and phasing verbatim (record 6676670839), the measurement, what is refused, the cold boot and its switch, what stays as §3.4 has it, the types to follow, where it is implemented. It states that after phase 3 the refusal remains only as the backstop for namespace-less packages, the shared `base`/`system`/`sys` namespaces and third-party packages in the deprecation window.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`** — the anchor.
- **`.changeset/30803-bare-name-one-package-holder.md`** — `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, both declaration lines, BREAKING Before / Now / Who moves / Unchanged, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, measured producers.

## Why (measured, stage 1)

Booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages sharing one bare name per type, both registration orders, on `c17719dd` (`stage1-measurement.md` in the seat's project folder):

| Type | Consumer | Served | Warned |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `picklist` | field `picklist: NAME`, `/meta/object` options + write validator | first-registered list for BOTH objects; the second package's own values refused `VALIDATION_FAILED` | no |
| `mapping` | `POST /data/OBJ/import` `{ mappingName }` | first-registered; the other package's import `400 MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH` | no |
| `dataset` | `POST /analytics/dataset/query` `{ datasetName }` | first-registered | no |

## Verification

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts` (new, 40 cells, real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, the `manifest` service door): per type × door — package door (both holders, rename, no record left), item seam, nested plugin, uninstall releases, same-package reload (CONTROL), environment registration never judged and never a holder (CONTROL); per type at the cold boot — boots and warns once naming both holders and the rename; both holders keep their name across a reload while a third is refused naming both; `'refuse'` refuses with the doors' envelope; the cold boot's reading (served holder as existing, sorted, one warning); no-clash boot is silent; every conflict in one refusal; no namespace, no rename; a built-in name; CONTROLs: a non-covered type (`page`) coexists, a picklist extension is no holder, `collisionPolicy: 'warn'` does not downgrade.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` (new, booted showcase + two `AppPlugin` packages + `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`): the cold boot boots and logs ONE `WARN` line naming all three names, both holders and the renames; `POST /marketplace/install-local` of a third package declaring the held picklist name is `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` naming both holders and `gamma_…`, package list unchanged; a package redeclaring the showcase's mapping and dataset names is refused naming `com.example.showcase`; CONTROL: fresh names install. 4 passed.
- Ablation (src): the engine plugin's seal call removed → 19 of the 40 unit cells red (every door refusal and the cold-boot warning), the 21 ablation/control cells stay green; restored. Ablation (dist): the dogfood file run against the pre-change `@objectstack/objectql` dist (dogfood imports it through dist) → 3 of 4 red (no warning line; both install-local cases `200`), the fresh-names CONTROL green; green after rebuilding the dist.
- `@objectstack/objectql` full suite: 556 files / 11108 tests passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (incl. the test-typecheck ratchet) exit 0.
- Gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 81 derived + 5 roster families, reconciled with `--ran`) and the full dogfood battery at this head (`75d1339f`, `origin/main` merged): both were running when this PR opened; their results are in the os-dev report on #30803.

## Kept (the card's three)

- Same-name actions on different objects stay keyed `objectName:name`; jobs stay keyed `appId:jobName` (`app-artifact-handlers.jobs.test.ts`); the unmanaged import's all-type refusal is untouched. Every existing security-catalog pin is unchanged (`registry-security-catalog-namespace.test.ts` and its siblings green in the full suite).

## Series and out of scope

- PR2–PR4 (same mechanism, own pins, §3.4's "to follow" list): `api`, object-less `action`, engine function registry; `email_template`, `webhook`, `connector`, `flow`; `agent`, `skill`. A type the security seat claims lands there instead (asked of the maintainer by the seat).
- **Candidates sharing a reader, not measured:** `tool` and `rag_pipeline` register by name like `agent` at the artifact door; included only on the seat's word.
- **Cloud carrier note (not filed):** the AI runtime consumers of agent/skill/tool names (`service-ai`: agents, skills, `action_NAME` tool names, ToolRegistry) live in `objectstack-ai/cloud`, not in this repo, and were NOT MEASURED here.
- Not refused: `analytics_cube` (a non-host package's cube never reaches the analytics service, 404 `CUBE_NOT_FOUND` both orders: a separate reach gap).

## Deviations

- The seal lives in the engine plugin's `kernel:bootstrapped` hook, not the registry's own doors: during a boot every package registers again, so the doors judge nothing until every package of the boot has registered. A kernel with `bootPhaseHooks: false` never seals (its doors never refuse); stated in the module doc and the ADR.
- Unlike the security catalog, the environment catalog is never a holder here: an environment item under a package's name is the ADR-0005 overlay (the seat's ruling 1).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request (first of a series by type family, per the seat).
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief is in Chinese by the seat's convention).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
